html:
Ao Dai Photo Shoot Experience in Ho Chi Minh City, offers international visitors a unique opportunity to wear Vietnam’s traditional costume and capture beautiful memories at the city’s most iconic landmarks. This private and small group experience is designed to provide comfort, personalization, and professional service throughout the journey.

From selecting a perfectly fitted ao dai to enjoying professional photography and guided posing, this experience combines cultural immersion with high quality photography. It is ideal for solo travelers, couples, families, and small groups who wish to preserve their Vietnam memories in an elegant and meaningful way.

ITINERARY

Step One: Ao Dai Selection and Preparation

Begin the experience at a professional showroom where you will choose your ao dai from a wide range of sizes, colors, and designs. Accessories, makeup, and hair styling are included. During preparation time, guests can relax with a fifteen foot massage and a facial mask.

Step Two: Private Transportation

Travel by private car with the Vietlook Travel team, including a professional photographer, lighting assistant, and interpreter. Transportation between locations is fully arranged for your convenience.

Step Three: Professional Photo Shoot

Take photos at selected iconic locations in Ho Chi Minh City. The photographer will provide clear posing instructions to ensure natural, elegant, and flattering photos, even for guests with no previous photo shoot experience.

Step Four: Hotel Drop Off

After the photo shoot, guests will be safely dropped off at their hotel.

Step Five: Photo Delivery

All original photos will be delivered within one day. Guests can then select their favorite images for editing. The edited photos will be delivered within five to seven days.

GROUP SIZE

One to four people

DURATION

Three and a half hours per location

PRICE

From 95 USD to 230 USD per person

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Ao dai rental with a wide selection of styles, colors, and sizes
  • Professional photographer with posing guidance
  • Private transportation with a dedicated support team
  • Photo sessions at iconic landmarks such as the Independence Palace, Central Post Office, and Opera House
  • All photos edited and delivered via Google Drive
  • Private or small group experience for maximum comfort and personalization
outline: Day 1: AO DAI PHOTO SHOOT EXPERIENCE
